Method: one gated Python wrapper, three actual extensions, same seed1 read-only Fortran array. Warm each build before timing. Use all six permutations once: B/U/G,B/G/U,U/B/G,U/G/B,G/B/U,G/U/B. Each build appears twice in each position; six timed fits/build/setting. No samples dropped or rerun.
Total 20 settings, 360 timed fits, 60 warm-ups. All 420 fits completed 100 lambdas without disallowed warnings. All output hashes agree across 3 builds, repetitions, and 1/8 threads.
Per-fit UTC start/end stamps, durations, variant, repeat and position are retained in raw JSONL, including warmups. Generation, warm-up, hashing and UTC bookkeeping are excluded from perf_counter timing.
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1. No commits, pushes or PRs.

Int8 sensitivity:
ungated: other/baseline median range 1.066493–1.116944; minimum range 1.061207–1.117659; fastest-three median range 1.067790–1.117947.
gated: other/baseline median range 0.974657–1.003771; minimum range 0.970351–0.999018; fastest-three median range 0.956342–1.001906.
On int8, ungated is 6.65–11.69% slower by median in all 8 settings; gated medians range 0.38% slower to 2.53% faster than baseline. Gated minima are 0.10–2.97% faster than baseline; ungated minima remain 6.12–11.77% slower.
Fastest-three medians are a uniform descriptive sensitivity check, not formal mode classification or proof of performance-core execution.
Int8 single-thread fits remain tightly grouped; no clear control-like two-mode pattern appears in their six-fit lists. Larger 8-thread cases show more spread and isolated faster/slower observations; six samples cannot identify core placement.
Tall float64 binomial controls still show distinct timing bands after the start gate. Baseline/gated median ratios span 0.913824–1.330655 and minimum ratios 0.995987–1.253341. Thus this run does not establish stable tall-control parity. At alpha 0.5 / thread 1 the baseline has no ~3.2 s observation whereas gated has five; minima cannot recover an unsampled mode.
Wide float64 binomial baseline/gated median ratios 0.993181–1.005781; Gaussian float64 baseline/gated 0.994878–1.006106. Full control data retained above.
